contentItem.title: 构造与求解：球与切线
contentItem.englishTitle: Given two spheres about the same centre, to inscribe in the greater sphere a polyhedral solid which does not touch the lesser sphere at its surface.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Given two spheres about the same centre, to inscribe in the greater sphere a polyhedral solid which does not touch the lesser sphere at its surface.
以同一中心的两个区域为例,在较大数量区域中输入一个不触动其表面较小区域的综合固体。
Let two spheres be conceived about the same centre A; thus it is required to inscribe in the greater sphere a polyhedral solid which does not touch the lesser sphere at its surface.
想象一下同一个A中心的两个球体;因此,需要在较大的球体中加入一个不触动其表面较小球体的多面体。

Let the spheres be cut by any plane through the centre; then the sections will be circles, inasmuch as the sphere was produced by the diameter remaining fixed and the semicircle being carried round it; [[XI. Def. 14](/principles/euclid-11-def-14)] hence, in whatever position we conceive the semicircle to be, the plane carried through it will produce a circle on the circumference of the sphere.
球体通过中间线被平面的球体切开;那么,球体将圈状,因为球体的直径被固定,半圈圈被绕绕;因此,无论我们设想半圈的位置如何,通过它所穿行的平面球体将扩大球体环绕的圆圈。 [[XI. Def. 14](/principles/euclid-11-def-14)]

And it is manifest that this circle is the greatest possible, inasmuch as the diameter of the sphere, which is of course the diameter both of the semicircle and of the circle, is greater than all the straight lines drawn across in the circle or the sphere.
显然,这个圆是最大的,因为球的直径——当然是半圆和圆的直径——大于圆或圆的所有直线。

Let then BCDE be the circle in the greater sphere, and FGH the circle in the lesser sphere; let two diameters in them, BD, CE, be drawn at right angles to one another; then, given the two circles BCDE, FGH about the same centre, let there be inscribed in the greater circle BCDE an equilateral polygon with an even number of sides which does not touch the lesser circle FGH, let BK, KL, LM ME be its sides in the quadrant BE. let KA be joined and carried through to N, let AO be set up from the point A at right angles to the plane of the circle BCDE, and let it meet the surface of the sphere at O, and through AO and each of the straight lines BD, KN let planes be carried; they will then make greatest circles on the surface of the sphere, for the reason stated.

将BCDE圆圈放在较大数量范围内,将FGH圆圈放在较小范围之内;将两个直径,即BD,CE直径,在直角个圆上画在彼此之间;然后,鉴于两个圆圈,BCDE,FGH圆上画在较大的圆上,将BCDE等边多边形个圆上,而两个边的长度与较小的圆上没有接触,FGH平面的圆上标在BE圆上,BK,KL,LM,ME圆上标在圆形的两边。将KA连接并传送到N,将AO安装在BCDE圆的A点到平面, 并让O圆圈的表面相交,通过AO圆圈,每条直线BD、KN圆圈平面圆,然后,由于所述原因,它们将在球表面形成最大的圆圈。
Let them make such, and in them let BOD, KON be the semicircles on BD, KN.
让它们做,在它们中,BOD,KON是BD,KN的半圆形。

Now, since OA is at right angles to the plane of the circle BCDE, therefore all the planes through OA are also at right angles to the plane of the circle BCDE; [[XI. 18](/principles/euclid-11-18)] hence the semicircles BOD, KON are also at right angles to the plane of the circle BCDE.
现在,由于OA是BCDE圈中的直角至平面,因此,平面至OA也都是BCDE圈中的直角至平面个;因此,BOD、KON半圆也是BCDE圆中的直角至平面个。 [[XI. 18](/principles/euclid-11-18)]
And, since the semicircles BED, BOD, KON are equal, for they are on the equal diameters BD, KN, therefore the quadrants BE, BO, KO are also equal to one another.
半圆BED,BOD,KON是相等的, 因为直径等于BD,KN, 所以四重体BE,BO,KO 也相等于对方。
Therefore there are as many straight lines in the quadrants BO, KO equal to the straight lines BK, KL, LM, ME as there are sides of the polygon in the quadrant BE.
因此,四重体BO,KO的直线与BK,KL,LM,ME的直线相等,而象体BE的多边形的两侧相同。

Let them be inscribed, and let them be BP, PQ, QR, RO and KS, ST, TU, UO, let SP, TQ, UR be joined, and from P, S let perpendiculars be drawn to the plane of the circle BCDE; [[XI. 11](/principles/euclid-11-11)] these will fall on BD, KN, the common sections of the planes, inasmuch as the planes of BOD, KON are also at right angles to the plane of the circle BCDE. [cf. [XI. Def. 4](/principles/euclid-11-def-4)]

将它们登记在BP、PQ、QR、RO和KS、ST、TU、UO、SP、TQ、UR连接,P、S直肠划入BCDE圈的平面个;这些相交点将相交点为平面,,KN,平面中共有部分,因为BOD,KON的平面个也位于BCDE圈的直角至平面（相关点与线段：BD）  [cf. [[XI. 11](/principles/euclid-11-11)] [XI. Def. 4](/principles/euclid-11-def-4)
Let them so fall, and let them be PV, SW, and let WV be joined.
让它们这样下降,让它们PV,SW, 让WV连接。

Now since, in the equal semicircles BOD, KON, equal straight lines BP, KS have been cut off, and the perpendiculars PV, SW have been drawn, therefore PV is equal to SW, and BV to KW. [[III. 27](/principles/euclid-3-27), [I. 26](/principles/euclid-1-26)]
现在,在相等的半圆BOD,KON,等直线BP,KS被切断,垂直PV,SW被抽取,因此PV等于SW,BV至KW [ [III. 27](/principles/euclid-3-27) [I. 26](/principles/euclid-1-26)

But the whole BA is also equal to the whole KA; therefore the remainder VA is also equal to the remainder WA; therefore, as BV is to VA, so is KW to WA; therefore WV is parallel to KB. [[VI. 2](/principles/euclid-6-2)]
但整个BA也等于整个KA;因此,其余VA也等于其余WA;因此,BV对VA的比等于KW对WA的比;因此,WV与KB并行；BV 与 VA 之比等于 KW 与 WA 之比。 [[VI. 2](/principles/euclid-6-2)]
And, since each of the straight lines PV, SW is at right angles to the plane of the circle BCDE, therefore PV is parallel to SW. [[XI. 6](/principles/euclid-11-6)]
由于PV线的每条直线,SW线是BCDE圈的直角至平面,因此PV线与SW线平行。 [[XI. 6](/principles/euclid-11-6)]
But it was also proved equal to it; therefore WV, SP are also equal and parallel. [[I. 33](/principles/euclid-1-33)]
但事实证明,它也与它相等;因此,WV,SP也是平等和平行的。 [[I. 33](/principles/euclid-1-33)]
And, since WV is parallel to SP, while WV is parallel to KB, therefore SP is also parallel to KB. [[XI. 9](/principles/euclid-11-9)]
还有因为WV和SP是平行的WV与KB平行因此,SP也是与KB并行的。 [[XI. 9](/principles/euclid-11-9)]

And BP, KS join their extremities; therefore the quadrilateral KBPS is in one plane, inasmuch as, if two straight lines be parallel, and points be taken at random on each of them, the straight line joining the points is in the same plane with the parallels. [[XI. 7](/principles/euclid-11-7)]
BP,KS连接它们的极限。 因此,四边KBPS是平面, 因为,如果两条直线平行, 并且每个直线上随机取点, 连接点的直线是平面和平行线。 [[XI. 7](/principles/euclid-11-7)]
For the same reason each of the quadrilaterals SPQT, TQRU is also in one plane.
出于同样的原因,每个四边形SPQT,TQRU也属于一个平面。
But the triangle URO is also in one plane. [[XI. 2](/principles/euclid-11-2)]
但三角形URO也在平面 [[XI. 2](/principles/euclid-11-2)]

If then we conceive straight lines joined from the points P, S, Q, T, R, U to A, there will be constructed a certain polyhedral solid figure between the circumferences BO, KO, consisting of pyramids of which the quadrilaterals KBPS, SPQT, TQRU and the triangle URO are the bases and the point A the vertex.
如果我们设想从P、S、Q、T、R、U至A点连接直线,则在环形BO、KO之间将建造一个某种多面固体数字,其中四边形KBPS、SPQT、TQRU和三角形URO为底边和顶端A。

And, if we make the same construction in the case of each of the sides KL, LM, ME as in the case of BK, and further in the case of the remaining three quadrants, there will be constructed a certain polyhedral figure inscribed in the sphere and contained by pyramids, of which the said quadrilaterals and the triangle URO, and the others corresponding to them, are the bases and the point A the vertex.
如果我们在双方KL、LM、ME方面进行同样的构造,在其余3个四角形体的情况下,在球体上将建有某种多面形图,由金字塔形成,其中所述四边形和三角形URO,以及与之相应的其他图象是底边和A点的顶端。（相关点与线段：BK）
I say that the said polyhedron will not touch the lesser sphere at the surface on which the circle FGH is.
我说,上述多面体不会触及FGH圆的表面的较小球体。
Let AX be drawn from the point A perpendicular to the plane of the quadrilateral KBPS, and let it meet the plane at the point X; [[XI. 11](/principles/euclid-11-11)] let XB, XK be joined.
让AX从A点直线到KBPS四边形的平面点,让它在X点相交平面;让XB、XK连接。 [[XI. 11](/principles/euclid-11-11)]

Then, since AX is at right angles to the plane of the quadrilateral KBPS, therefore it is also at right angles to all the straight lines which meet it and are in the plane of the quadrilateral. [[XI. Def. 3](/principles/euclid-11-def-3)]
之后,由于AX是KBPS四边形的直角到平面,因此,它也是直角,横交于四边形的平面。 [[XI. Def. 3](/principles/euclid-11-def-3)]
Therefore AX is at right angles to each of the straight lines BX, XK.
因此,AX线每条直线为直角,BX,XK。
And, since AB is equal to AK, the square on AB is also equal to the square on AK.
AB等于AK,AB等于正方形等于AK。
And the squares on AX, XB are equal to the square on AB, for the angle at X is right; [[I. 47](/principles/euclid-1-47)] and the squares on AX, XK are equal to the square on AK. [id.]
AX,XB的正方形等于AB的正方形,X的角是正确的;AX,XK的正方形等于AK的正方形。 [[I. 47](/principles/euclid-1-47)]
Therefore the squares on AX, XB are equal to the squares on AX, XK.
因此,AX和XB正方形等于AX和XK正方形。
Let the square on AX be subtracted from each; therefore the remainder, the square on BX, is equal to the remainder, the square on XK; therefore BX is equal to XK.
将每组的正方形和AX减一减,因此其余的正方形和BX等于其余的正方形和XK;因此,BX等于XK。
Similarly we can prove that the straight lines joined from X to P, S are equal to each of the straight lines BX, XK.
同样,我们可以证明,连接X至P的直线等于BX至XK的直线。（相关点与线段：S）
Therefore the circle described with centre X and distance one of the straight lines XB, XK will pass through P, S also, and KBPS will be a quadrilateral in a circle.
因此,以X中枢和XB直线之一的距离所描述的圆形将穿过P、S和KBPS,在圆形中将是一个四边形。（相关点与线段：XK）
Now, since KB is greater than WV, while WV is equal to SP, therefore KB is greater than SP.
现在,KB比WV,WV等于SP,KB大于SP。
But KB is equal to each of the straight lines KS, BP; therefore each of the straight lines KS, BP is greater than SP.
但KB等于每条KS,BP;因此,每条KS,BP大于SP。
And, since KBPS is a quadrilateral in a circle, and KB, BP, KS are equal, and PS less, and BX is the radius of the circle, therefore the square on KB is greater than double of the square on BX.
KBPS是圆形的四边形, KB, BP, KS是等值, PS是少, BX是圆形的半径, 因此, KB 的正方形是BX 的正方形的两倍。
Let KZ be drawn from K perpendicular to BV.
将KZ从垂直的K抽到BV。

Then, since BD is less than double of DZ, and, as BD is to DZ, so is the rectangle DB, BZ to the rectangle DZ, ZB, if a square be described upon BZ and the parallelogram on ZD be completed, then the rectangle DB, BZ is also less than double of the rectangle DZ, ZB.
BD比DZ少一倍,BD比DZ,矩形、DB比矩形、DZ,ZB,如果BZ比正方形比ZB,正方形比平行四边形比ZD比DZ,BZ也比矩形、DZ少一倍

And, if KD be joined, the rectangle DB, BZ is equal to the square on BK, and the rectangle DZ, ZB equal to the square on KZ; [[III. 31](/principles/euclid-3-31), [VI. 8 and Por.](/principles/euclid-6-8)] therefore the square on KB is less than double of the square on KZ.
如果连接到KD, 矩形, DB, BZ等于BK的正方形, 矩形, DZ, ZB等于KZ的正方形, 因此, KB的正方形比KZ的正方形少一倍。 [ [III. 31](/principles/euclid-3-31) [VI. 8 and Por.](/principles/euclid-6-8)
But the square on KB is greater than double of the square on BX; therefore the square on KZ is greater than the square on BX.
但是,KB比正方形比BX比正方形要多一倍;因此,KZ比正方形比BX比正方形。
And, since BA is equal to KA, the square on BA is equal to the square on AK.
BA等于KA,BA等于正方形等于AK。

And the squares on BX, XA are equal to the square on BA, and the squares on KZ, ZA equal to the square on KA; [[I. 47](/principles/euclid-1-47)] therefore the squares on BX, XA are equal to the squares on KZ, ZA, and of these the square on KZ is greater than the square on BX; therefore the remainder, the square on ZA, is less than the square on XA.
BX,XA的正方形等于BA的正方形、KZ正方形,ZAKA正方形;因此,BX,XA的正方形等于KZ,ZA的正方形。其中,KZ中的正方形大于BX中的正方形;因此,其余的正方形比ZA比正方形比XA还少。 [[I. 47](/principles/euclid-1-47)]
Therefore AX is greater than AZ; therefore AX is much greater than AG.
因此,AX件大于AZ件,AX件大大高于AG件。
And AX is the perpendicular on one base of the polyhedron, and AG on the surface of the lesser sphere; hence the polyhedron will not touch the lesser sphere on its surface.
AX是1,底边个聚合面的直角,AG在小球表面; 因此,聚合面不会触动其表面的较小球。
Therefore, given two spheres about the same centre, a polyhedral solid has been inscribed in the greater sphere which does not touch the lesser sphere at its surface. Q. E. F.
因此,鉴于同一中心的两个区域,一个多面固体被刻在较大的数量范围内,而这个范围在表面没有触及较小的范围。

Porism. But if in another sphere also a polyhedral solid be inscribed similar to the solid in the sphere BCDE, the polyhedral solid in the sphere BCDE has to the polyhedral solid in the other sphere the ratio triplicate of that which the diameter of the sphere BCDE has to the diameter of the other sphere.
固态。但是如果在另一个球体中也刻有类似于BCDE球体中的固态的聚态固体,则BCDE球体中的多态固体与另一个球体中的多态固体具有BCDE球体直径的三重比。
For, the solids being divided into their pyramids similar in multitude and arrangement, the pyramids will be similar.
因为,固体被分成金字塔 数量和排列相似, 金字塔也相似。

But similar pyramids are to one another in the triplicate ratio of their corresponding sides; [[XII. 8, Por.](/principles/euclid-12-8)] therefore the pyramid of which the quadrilateral KBPS is the base, and the point A the vertex, has to the similarly arranged pyramid in the other sphere the ratio triplicate of that which the corresponding side has to the corresponding side, that is, of that which the radius AB of the sphere about A as centre has to the radius of the other sphere.
但类似的金字塔在立方比个对应面上相互相似;因此,金字塔的四边KBPS是底边,顶点A, 与另一球中类似排列的金字塔有三重比,对应面与对应面,即,球半径A,与中点A相近。（相关点与线段：AB） [[XII. 8, Por.](/principles/euclid-12-8)]

Similarly also each pyramid of those in the sphere about A as centre has to each similarly arranged pyramid of those in the other sphere the ratio triplicate of that which AB has to the radius of the other sphere.
同样,球体中大约A左右的金字塔,对球体中每个类似排列的金字塔,对另一个球体中每个类似排列的金字塔,AB球体中每个区域与另一个球体半径的三重比。

And, as one of the antecedents is to one of the consequents, so are all the antecedents to all the consequents; [[V. 12](/principles/euclid-5-12)] hence the whole polyhedral solid in the sphere about A as centre has to the whole polyhedral solid in the other sphere the ratio triplicate of that which AB has to the radius of the other sphere, that is, of that which the diameter BD has to the diameter of the other sphere. Q. E. D.
并且,作为前奏之一,所有后奏的前奏之一,也都是前奏; 因此,球体中整个多面固体大约A,因为中间的中间体对另一球体中整个多面固体的比重是AB球体与其他球体半径的三重,即直径BD球体直径的三重。 [[V. 12](/principles/euclid-5-12)]
